movie_title: What’s Hiding at the Most Solitary Place on Earth? The Deep Sea

vocabulary.definition: the production and emission of light by living organisms
vocabulary.example: The anglerfish uses bioluminescence to attract prey in the dark depths of the ocean.

vocabulary.definition: microorganisms that thrive in extreme environments
vocabulary.example: Extremophiles living in volcanic vents at the ocean floor can withstand high temperatures and pressure.

vocabulary.definition: relating to or denoting the depths or bed of the ocean, especially between 3,000 and 6,000 meters
vocabulary.example: Abyssal creatures have adapted to the high pressures and low temperatures of the deep sea.
The extensive coral reef system in the Great Barrier Reef is a marvel of marine biodiversity.

vocabulary.definition: maintaining or keeping alive or in existence
vocabulary.example: Conservation efforts are crucial for preserving the delicate ecosystems of the deep sea.
The fascinating behavior of deep-sea creatures continues to intrigue marine biologists.
